req.title: Delete post
req.statement: The system shall remove the post row and redirect to / when POST /<id>/delete is issued by the post's author.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that a post should be deleted only by its author and the system should redirect to the index page. Tests are designed to cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_delete_post_by_author
preconditions: Post with id 1 exists and is authored by 'test'
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as 'test'
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})

# Delete post
r = client.post('/1/delete')

# Assertions
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'  # Redirect to index

# Verify post deletion
r = client.get('/')
assert b'test title' not in r.data

tests.name: test_delete_post_by_non_author
preconditions: Post with id 1 exists and is authored by 'test'
expected: Post with id 1 is not deleted
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as 'other'
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'other', 'password': 'other'})

# Attempt to delete post
r = client.post('/1/delete')

# Assertions
assert r.status_code == 403

# Verify post still exists
r = client.get('/')
assert b'test title' in r.data

tests.name: test_delete_non_existent_post
preconditions: Post with id 2 does not exist
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as 'test'
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})

# Attempt to delete non-existent post
r = client.post('/2/delete')

# Assertions
assert r.status_code == 404
